economic_rationale: Broad-dollar volatility is an external funding-stress state rather than another BTC direction signal. It is useful only if a permanent half-size BTC core retains most upside while high-volatility de-risking materially improves after-cost drawdown and Calmar with annual and 8/26-week neighbor breadth.
mechanism: From sealed weekly DTWEXBGS means, compute annualized RMS weekly-log-change volatility over 13 weeks. After Friday plus five calendar days, compare it with the median of the prior 52 available 13-week values excluding current. Hold 50 percent BTC during a strictly higher-volatility state and 100 percent otherwise, changing target only at the next H1 open. Eight-week and 26-week versions are rejection-only neighbors.
thesis: A causally lagged high broad-dollar-volatility state identifies external funding stress in which reducing BTC from full exposure to a permanent half-size core improves matched-capital after-cost risk-adjusted performance over buy-and-hold.
title: Broad-dollar volatility passive-core BTC risk overlay
